runtime_uncertainties: Frozen evidence inventory contains no accepted recordings; all selected cases need new construction and proof.
Native junction identity and polygon alone may not establish one statutory median-opening crossing; sourced roadway definition and realized geometry remain to be reviewed.
Native Off state alone is not proof of statutory inoperability or official installed/uncovered signal heads.
Current measurements cover entry order and ego approach but not a complete yield/cautious-stop history or left-turn exception.

Exact runner, four cameras, saved finalizer, three fallbacks per selected case, semantic proposals, exact offline/compatibility/saved-processing proofs and independent audits remain worker-owned CPU work.
